C0667.title: Man Sentenced for Extorting Over 20 Restaurants by Falsely Claiming Flies in Food
C0667.summary: Chen, a man born after 2000, falsely claimed more than 20 times that he found flies in delivered meals and maliciously demanded compensation from merchants, extorting over 8,000 yuan from 29 merchants within four months. The Beijing Changping Court held that his repeated extortion of others' property constituted extortion and sentenced him to seven months in prison, suspended for one year, and a 3,000 yuan fine. The case shows the criminal risk of using fabricated food-safety complaints for malicious claims.
